publication.title: Visual Data and Schema Queries over Knowledge Graphs

source_reading.scope: All main sections1–4 and supporting-material footnotes; references inspected for companion links.

adjudication.basis: The method exposes KG schema metadata as RDF and demonstrates visual queries over both Nobel Prize domain instances and schema instances in ViziQuer. The metadata is itself an inspected/queryable KG object; direct replacement of the relational schema store by KG storage is future work.
